name: ICrash
brief: Iterative crash procedure for LP starting points

algorithms.name:
Crossover to Basic Solution:
  Convert crash point to basic feasible solution:
algorithms.math:
Given x_crash, find basis B such that x_B = B⁻¹b is feasible
        Uses primal/dual simplex pivots from crash point
  callCrossover() integrates with HiGHS simplex.
ref:
Nocedal, J. and Wright, S. (2006). "Numerical Optimization".
       Springer, Chapter 17.

Boyd, S. et al. (2011). "Distributed optimization and statistical
       learning via ADMM". Foundations and Trends in ML 3(1):1-122.
